goal: The main photo (or the first text of a list) is on screen in under 2.5 seconds on a phone with a 4G connection, on home pages and on listing pages. Layout shift under 0.1. Measured with seo/tech/measure.cjs (Chrome, 1.6 Mbit/s, 150 ms latency, 4x slower processor).
kb_are: gzip, as seo/tech/serve.mjs sends them; the live site uses Brotli and is about 15% lighter
live_note: Limits for seo/tech/browserCheck.mjs after every publication: kilobytes really transferred (Brotli, photos included) and requests on a first visit with an empty cache, phone screen, no service worker. Measured 21-nov-2026 (home 1567 KB / 58, deal 1956 / 59, country 1288 / 46, band 1204 / 43, map 1235 / 55); the limits leave about a quarter of room.
